records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Compelling two-year stacked comparable sales: For the second quarter, total Chico’s FAS comparable sales decreased 3.0% versus last year’s second quarter and increased 16.5% on a two-year stacked basis.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Chico’s comparable sales decreased 2.5% versus the second quarter last year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At the end of the second quarter, inventories totaled $300.2 million compared to $338.8 million at the end of last year’s second quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For all three brands, full-priced sales remained healthy, and year-over-year total Company average dollar spend and units per transaction increased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Strong operating income: Second quarter income from operations was $46.5 million, or 8.5% of net sales, reflecting solid gross margin performance combined with continued, disciplined expense management and investment in the Company’s growth strategies.
